home.intro_p1: We connect our farms directly with consumers, giving you fresher products at honest prices while ensuring the people who grow your food create more value.
home.products_subtitle: From nutrient-rich vegetables to naturally grown fruits and staple cereals, we bring the harvest closer to home.
home.tana_lead_2: , produces organic products straight from its own land.
home.tana_body: Tana Farm extends our farm-to-table philosophy by growing and providing fresh, organic products directly from the farm. No unnecessary middlemen. No unnecessary distance. Just products that come straight from the land to the people.
home.values_subtitle: We believe agriculture works best when the distance between the farmer and the family buying their food is kept short.
home.v1_desc: We reduce unnecessary layers between farms and consumers, creating a simpler supply chain.
home.v2_desc: Shorter journeys mean our produce reaches your home fresher and closer to the harvest.
home.v3_desc: By cutting out resellers and unnecessary markups, we work toward prices that make sense.
home.v4_desc: We are building an agricultural business that values quality, people and long-term sustainability.
home.cta_subtitle: Interested in our products, availability or a direct order? We'd love to hear from you.

about.hero_subtitle: Empowering farmers and agricultural enterprises with high-yield seeds, premium crop nutrition, modern equipment, and sustainable farming solutions.
about.story_title: Pioneering Sustainable Agriculture for Half a Century
about.story_p1_before: Founded with a deep passion for the land and farming communities,
about.story_p1_after: has grown from a humble regional crop producer into a trusted national and international agricultural supplier.
about.story_p2: We bridge the gap between traditional agricultural wisdom and modern agronomic science. From non-GMO certified seeds to precision organic fertilizers and heavy-duty farming machinery, we provide everything modern farmers need to maximize crop yields while preserving soil health.
about.organic_badge_desc: Dedicated to sustainable crop production and clean soil preservation.
about.value_quality_desc: Every seed, fertilizer blend, and tool is thoroughly tested to guarantee high germination and reliability.
about.value_global_desc: We adhere to international organic farming standards, serving domestic growers and international export partners.
about.value_farmer_desc: Our team provides 24/7 customer support and agronomy consultation to ensure your farming journey succeeds.
